shortDescription: MPPSC Assistant Town Planner ATP Admit Card 2026 update for Advertisement No. 02/2026. The examination is scheduled for 20 September 2026; download the hall ticket from the official MPPSC portal when released.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the recruitment update for Assistant Town Planner (ATP) 2026 under Advertisement No. 02/2026.

The recruitment covers 39 Assistant Town Planner posts. The examination is scheduled for 20 September 2026, and the admit card is expected before the examination. Candidates should download the hall ticket from the official MPPSC portal and verify the exam centre, reporting time and other instructions.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 01 July 2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 31 July 2026
  • Correction window: 05 July to 02 August 2026
  • Last date with late fee: 26 August 2026
  • Exam date: 20 September 2026
  • Admit card: Before examination

Eligibility

Candidates should have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Planning from a recognized university. Read the complete MPPSC notification for the exact qualification and category-wise vacancy details.

Download the admit card only from the official MPPSC website and carry a valid photo ID along with the printed hall ticket.
importantInstructions: The admit card release status and examination instructions should be confirmed from the official MPPSC portal. Read the complete notification before appearing for the examination.
